Config.Title: Monster HUD — {name}
Config.Intro: Choose quick abilities and configure the Multiattack groups shown in the overlay.
Config.QuickActionsHint: Each ability appears once and uses the artwork from its Item sheet.
Config.AutoQuick: Suggest actions automatically when selection is empty
Config.NoActions: This NPC has no usable abilities.
Config.MultiattackHint: Select its abilities and clearly set how many times each one can be used. A shared pool remains available for free combinations.
Config.TimesHint: Number of times this ability can be used in the Multiattack

HUD.ResistSave: Turn the latest failed save into a success
HUD.Drag: Drag the HUD; double-click its header to reset the position

Warnings.MultiattackSpent: This Multiattack is already complete. Use is still allowed.
Warnings.ActionSpent: This ability appears depleted. Use is still allowed.

Errors.WrongSystem: Khuzoe Monster HUD requires the D&D 5e system.
Errors.ActorUnavailable: The Actor to configure is unavailable.
Errors.OwnerRequired: You must own the Actor to configure its Monster HUD.

Enabled.Name: Enable Monster HUD
Enabled.Hint: Show the overlay when controlling an NPC or player-character token.

FollowCombat.Name: Follow current combatant
FollowCombat.Hint: When no token is controlled, automatically show the NPC whose turn it is.

AllowOwners.Name: Allow NPC owners to use the HUD
AllowOwners.Hint: Allow player owners of an NPC to use its overlay. Player characters are always available to their owners.

Scale.Name: Overlay scale
Scale.Hint: Resize Monster HUD on your client.
